title: Cancer and Capricorn move in.
old_caption:
Moving in together and only one shelf?
Cancer and Capricorn make room for the shell and the calendar. Home is a schedule and a feeling.

title: Dear Nashville.
old_caption:
Pisces, still writing sad songs about love?
In Nashville, someone brings a tambourine. Try a major key for once.

title: Every new moon is a fresh start.
old_caption:
If you could write one line about what you want in love, what would it say?
The new moon is a fresh start. Begin with one line.

title: Dear New Orleans.
old_caption:
Do you only celebrate the big dates?
A tiny cupcake on a Tuesday counts too. Celebrate the small stuff.

title: Dear New York.
old_caption:
Five group chats going and zero actual plans?
Gemini learns busy is not an excuse. Make one plan and keep it.

title: Leo and Aquarius make it official.
old_caption:
Two stubborn signs actually making it official?
Leo shares the spotlight, Aquarius takes the headphones off. Fixed means committed.

title: Tex-Mex is a love language.
old_caption:
Is your partner a double dipper?
Virgo and Pisces learn to laugh about the small stuff. Pick your battles, not the queso.

title: Leo and Aquarius make up.
old_caption:
Sitting on opposite ends of the couch after a fight?
Somebody goes first: say sorry, say what you need, then listen. Repair is romantic.

title: The stars' Houston report card.
old_caption:
What if the city graded you back?
The stars came to give Houston advice, and Houston taught them something too.

title: Retro the gremlin
old_caption:
About to send an ex a text at 2 AM?
Mercury retrograde is for reflecting, not resending. Leo puts the phone face down.
